role: A netty channel handler that answers the legacy pre-1.6 server-list ping (0xFE request, 0xFF response with MOTD, player count and version string) on the server's listen socket.
scope_reason: The oracle client joins through the in-process local channel; nothing ever connects to a real listen socket to ping a server list, and the native engine has no sockets at all.

members.name: func_151256_a
members.note: writes the response and closes the channel

notes: Pure server-list plumbing; never reached in any oracle run or native replay.
